csv_scope_of_work: Illinois State University seeks statements of qualifications and proposals from experienced higher education campus planning firms and multidisciplinary consultant teams to prepare a comprehensive Campus Master Plan. The Master Plan will establish a long-range, implementable framework to guide physical development, land use, space utilization, infrastructure renewal, mobility, landscape and open space planning, and capital investment decisions in support of the Universitys academic mission, student experience, operational effectiveness, and responsible stewardship of campus resources. The planning effort should integrate facilities, site systems, landscape character, transportation networks, utilities, infrastructure, accessibility, sustainability, deferred maintenance considerations, and future development opportunities in order to identify practical strategies for renewal, adaptation, redevelopment, and future growth.
